releaseVersion.policy: Marketing version is shared across platforms. Every submitted binary must monotonically increase the platform build number/version code; marketing version changes are explicit release decisions.

complianceInventory.reason: No public, versioned privacy-policy route/URL is frozen in the repository.
The authenticated mobile My flow has no account-deletion entry or request flow.
No public web deletion-request resource is frozen for Google Play metadata.
The iOS client implements native Sign in with Apple and Supabase Apple ID-token exchange. Apple Developer/Supabase provider authority remains external and must be verified before store submission.
Expo config does not freeze a BEJEWELY production icon/adaptive icon asset for store binaries.
App Store/Play screenshots, feature/promotional graphics and final listing assets are not frozen.
Generated app and third-party SDK required-reason API declarations must be audited before submission metadata is frozen.
Data Safety answers must be derived from the final production data flow and included SDKs.
App Store export-compliance answers must be frozen from the final networking/cryptography dependency set.
App Store age rating and Google Play content-rating declarations are not frozen.
Store copy must be reviewed to avoid unsupported diagnostic or medical claims.

passMeans: MOBILE-13 release-preflight identity, toolchain, permission and native build contracts remain preserved.
Google OAuth keeps the frozen bejewely custom-scheme callback and the repository records that hosted redirect allow-list verification remains external.
iOS exposes native Sign in with Apple through Expo Apple Authentication and exchanges the Apple identity token with Supabase.
iOS Universal Links and Android App Links are scoped to the canonical production host and public /r/* report path.
The canonical web origin exposes association endpoints that fail closed until Apple Team ID and Android production signing SHA-256 authority are supplied.
Known store compliance and external-authority blockers remain explicit and fail-visible.
passDoesNotMean: App Store or Google Play submission readiness.
Bundle/package identifier availability or external registration.
Supabase hosted redirect allow-list or Apple provider configuration has been verified.
A real Apple Team ID or Android production signing certificate fingerprint has been registered on the production domain.
Privacy policy/Data Safety/App Privacy metadata completion.
